nodes.label: Document Inventory Skill
nodes.rationale: Inventory human-readable testing documents by business categories rather than indiscriminately scanning code and asset files.

nodes.label: Document Extension Whitelist
nodes.rationale: The default scope excludes code and assets to keep the inventory aligned with documents a test engineer can actually use.

nodes.label: Legacy Document Inventory Demonstration
nodes.rationale: The demonstration exposes noise from broad extension scanning and motivates the newer document-only scope and business-first summary.

nodes.label: Test-Friendly PRD
nodes.rationale: Requirements should be quantitative, scenario-complete, and verifiable so they can directly support test-case design.

nodes.label: Visible Format Degradation Notice
nodes.rationale: Formatting failures must be visible to readers and must never silently masquerade as a fully preserved report.

nodes.label: BugStats Single Fact Source
nodes.rationale: All report channels consume one immutable statistics artifact to prevent count, title, module, and conclusion drift.

nodes.label: Skill Progressive Disclosure
nodes.rationale: Keep core skill instructions lean while loading detailed resources only when relevant.

nodes.label: Per-Project Custom Field Mapping
nodes.rationale: Custom field IDs vary by project, so runtime mapping prevents cross-project data corruption.

nodes.label: Bug Creation Dry-Run Safety
nodes.rationale: Inspecting the request body before a write reduces irreversible defect-creation errors.
